name: Texas-Style Beef Chili without Beans
steps: Brown the cubed beef in oil.
Add the onion, garlic, jalapeno and spices.
Stir in the tomatoes, paste and broth and simmer 80 minutes until tender.

name: Brisket-Style Slow Cooker Beef with Barbecue Rub
steps: Rub the beef with the spice mix.
Place on the onion in a slow cooker with the broth and vinegar.
Cook on low for 8 hours and shred or slice.

name: Smoked Turkey Breast with Dry Rub
steps: Rub the turkey with oil, vinegar and the spices.
Roast at 300°F, or smoke, until it reaches 165°F, about 2 hours.
Rest and slice.

name: Barbecue Ribs, Oven-Baked
steps: Rub the pork with the spices.
Wrap tightly and bake at 300°F for 2 hours.
Brush with a sauce of paste, vinegar and sweetener and finish under the broiler.

name: BBQ Chicken Quarters with Corn on the Cob
steps: Whisk the paste, vinegar, paprika and sweetener.
Roast the chicken at 425°F for 35 minutes, brushing with sauce.
Grill or boil the corn and brush with butter.

name: Cowboy Caviar Chicken Bowls
steps: Season and grill the chicken, then slice.
Mix the beans, corn, pepper, onion, lime and cilantro.
Serve over rice with chicken and avocado.

name: Tex-Mex Chicken Tortilla Soup
steps: Simmer the chicken, onion, tomatoes, spices and broth for 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken and add the beans and corn.
Serve with strips of crisped tortilla, avocado and cilantro.

name: Carne Asada Street Tacos
steps: Marinate the steak in lime, garlic and cumin for 30 minutes.
Grill 4 minutes a side, rest and chop.
Warm the tortillas and fill with steak, onion, cilantro and salsa.

name: Chicken Tinga Tostadas
steps: Poach and shred the chicken.
Simmer with chipotle, tomato sauce and onion for 10 minutes.
Crisp the tortillas in a hot oven.
Top with beans, chicken, lettuce and cotija.

name: Fish Tostadas with Lime Cabbage
steps: Season the tilapia and pan-sear 3 minutes a side.
Crisp the tortillas in the oven.
Toss the cabbage with lime and yogurt.
Top the tostadas with fish, slaw and avocado.

name: Taco Soup
steps: Brown the beef with the onion.
Add the beans, corn, tomatoes, broth and taco seasoning and simmer 20 minutes.
Top with cheddar.

name: Tamale Pie Casserole
steps: Brown the turkey with the onion and chili powder; stir in beans, corn and sauce.
Stir the egg into the cooked grits for the crust.
Spread the filling in a dish, cover with grits and cheddar.
Bake at 375°F for 30 minutes.

name: Midwest Hotdish with Ground Beef and Green Beans
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and mushrooms.
Stir in the beans, milk and thyme.
Top with sliced potatoes and cheddar and bake at 375°F for 40 minutes.

name: Chicken and Wild Rice Soup
steps: Simmer the chicken, vegetables and thyme in the broth for 25 minutes.
Shred the chicken and add the cooked wild rice and milk.
Heat through gently.

name: Bratwurst-Style Turkey Sausage with Sauerkraut and Apple
steps: Brown the sausages in oil.
Add the onion and apple and cook until soft.
Warm the sauerkraut with them and serve with mustard.

name: Cheese Curd-Style Baked Cauliflower Bites
steps: Toss the florets in egg and almond flour.
Roast on an oiled tray at 425°F for 20 minutes.
Top with mozzarella for the last 5.

name: New England Baked Cod with Herb Crumbs
steps: Crumb the bread and mix with melted butter, parsley and garlic.
Top the cod and bake at 400°F for 15 minutes.
Serve with lemon and steamed green beans.

name: Lobster Roll Lettuce Wraps
steps: Chop the cooked lobster.
Mix with celery, mayo, yogurt, lemon and chives.
Spoon into lettuce leaves.

name: Maine-Style Lobster Roll on a Toasted Bun
steps: Toss the cooked lobster with lemon, chives and celery.
Toast the buns in butter.
Fill generously.

name: Boston Baked Beans without Molasses
steps: Combine everything in a pot.
Bake covered at 300°F for 2 hours, adding water as needed.

name: Cape Cod Turkey Burger with Cranberry Mustard
steps: Mix the turkey with chopped cranberries and salt and shape four patties.
Pan-sear 6 minutes a side.
Toast the buns and spread with mustard.
Build with arugula and onion.

name: Hawaiian Chicken Skewers with Pineapple
steps: Marinate the chicken in soy sauce, ginger, garlic and sesame oil.
Thread onto skewers with pineapple, pepper and onion.
Grill 10 to 12 minutes and serve over rice.

name: Poke Bowl with Tuna and Cucumber
steps: Cube the tuna and toss with soy sauce and sesame oil.
Divide the rice among bowls.
Top with tuna, cucumber, avocado, green onion, sesame seeds and nori.

name: Kalua-Style Pork with Cabbage
steps: Rub the pork with salt and paprika.
Slow cook with the water for 8 hours.
Shred and stir in the steamed cabbage.

name: Pacific Northwest Cedar-Style Salmon with Asparagus
steps: Brush the salmon with mustard, oil, garlic and dill.
Roast at 400°F for 15 minutes with the asparagus.
Serve with lemon.

name: Seattle-Style Teriyaki Chicken Plate
steps: Sear the chicken in oil, then glaze with soy sauce, ginger, garlic, vinegar and sweetener.
Steam or sauté the cabbage.
Serve with rice.

name: California Cobb Burrito Bowl
steps: Grill and slice the chicken; boil and slice the eggs; crisp the bacon.
Arrange everything over the romaine.
Dress with lime and oil.

name: San Diego Shrimp Ceviche Cups
steps: Poach the shrimp 2 minutes, chop and chill.
Marinate in the lime juice for 20 minutes.
Fold in tomato, cucumber, onion, jalapeno and cilantro.
Serve with avocado.

name: Southwest Stuffed Peppers with Turkey and Rice
steps: Halve the peppers and parboil 4 minutes.
Brown the turkey with the spices; mix with rice, beans and tomatoes.
Fill the peppers, top with cheddar and bake at 375°F for 25 minutes.
